# pve-rclone-backup retention

Preview and apply offsite retention (the storage's prune-backups).

Offsite retention uses the storage's prune-backups setting, marked exactly like PVE's own prune,
with safety rails: rclone-min-age, rclone-keep-min, keeping the newest good copy while a newer backup
is damaged, and rclone-max-deletes per run. Removed backups are tombstoned and deleted after
rclone-delete-grace; until then 'backup undelete' restores them.

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`preview`](#retention-preview) | Show what retention would remove |
| [`run`](#retention-run) | Apply retention now and delete backups whose grace period ended |

## retention preview

Show what retention would remove.

```
pve-rclone-backup retention preview <storage> [flags]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--type string` | only qemu or lxc guests |
| `--vmid int` | only this guest |

## retention run

Apply retention now and delete backups whose grace period ended.

```
pve-rclone-backup retention run <storage>
```

Every command also accepts the [global options](index.md#global-options).
